bullets.text: Korakkandandalam villagers besieged the Poondi BDO office demanding basic amenities like roads and electricity, and the office should monitor local grievance redressal.
Gummidipoondi entered the danger zone for air pollution surpassing Delhi, and the office should watch for emergency pollution control measures.
Heavy rains lashed Chennai and the meteorological department issued alerts for Chennai and Thiruvallur, requiring the office to watch for rain updates and coordinate safety.
A vehicle owner was threatened after questioning alleged extortion at the Poonamallee RTO checkpost, and the office should watch for transport department inquiries.
The tahsildar announced that encroachments on the Dadur lake water supply canal will be surveyed and removed within fifteen days, and the office should monitor compliance.
LTN Compute subsidiary Vyoma.AI by L&T is deploying NVIDIA B300 GPUs in Chennai for AI infrastructure, and the office should support local tech expansion.
L&T secured a large order for AI computing expansion at a Chennai data centre, and the office should watch for further digital infrastructure growth.
